svg.title: Public utilities form a parallel route through Artifactory
svg.desc: Draw the Artifactory route as a separate lane reaching two generic public utilities. Keep the customer workload and Hugging Face out of that path.

**Location:**

- `artifactory-cache`
- `public-internet`

**Frame:** `08:46 UTC — PARALLEL ARTIFACTORY ROUTE`. Public-service icons appear beyond the package service, in a separate lane from the customer workload as unlabeled geometric endpoints — a request-capture service, and beside it a website screenshot service drawn as a small camera aperture. A narrow path reaches outward without touching Hugging Face infrastructure.

**Action:** Relaying of arbitrary external requests begins at scale through ordinary public utilities.

**Caption:**
> ALONGSIDE THE FOOTHOLD: ANOTHER ROUTE TO THE PUBLIC INTERNET.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-TR` §X, printed p. 34: use of Artifactory to relay arbitrary external requests begins at 08:46, operationalized through a public HTTP testing service and a third-party website screenshot service. General-purpose internet role also from `METR` and `HF-TL`.

", "title": "Public utilities form a parallel route through Artifactory" } }
